key_news.headline: Meta to invest $10+ billion in Indiana AI data center
key_news.summary: Meta will spend more than $10 billion to build a data center campus in Lebanon, Indiana, among the company's largest AI infrastructure investments. Expected operational by end 2027/early 2028.

key_news.headline: EU formally charges Meta with antitrust violations over AI dominance
key_news.summary: European Commission charged Meta with violating EU antitrust rules by leveraging messaging dominance to stifle AI assistant competition, specifically excluding rival AI from WhatsApp platform.

key_news.headline: Bill Ackman reveals stake in Meta, cites 'deeply discounted valuation'
key_news.summary: Pershing Square disclosed position in Meta, with Ackman stating the company has deeply discounted valuation despite AI investment concerns.

key_news.headline: Meta lays off 1,000 Reality Labs employees, shifts focus to AI
key_news.summary: Meta confirmed cuts affecting ~1,000 Reality Labs roles, representing strategic shift toward AI and away from metaverse investments. Up to 30% budget cuts planned for metaverse unit.
